semiconductor_relevance: Medium — King Sun Industry Co., Ltd. provides critical infrastructure components and services that support semiconductor fabrication facilities.
summary: King Sun Industry Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing components and accessories essential for semiconductor fabrication facilities. Their offerings include cooling towers, ventilation fans, and modular water tanks, which are vital for maintaining optimal operating conditions and efficient water management in semiconductor manufacturing processes. The company also provides spare parts and maintenance services for equipment used in semiconductor production.
